changelog:
• 🚀 Local Streaming Proxy: Embedded high-throughput StreamProxyServer on 127.0.0.1 to eliminate buffering stalls on 4K streams
• ⚡ 4MB High-Throughput Socket Engine: Configured RFC 1323 TCP window scaling (4MB SO_RCVBUF) to unlock 10-20 MB/s over transatlantic CDNs
• 🎬 Asynchronous MediaCodec: Enabled asynchronous MediaCodec queueing on Android TV hardware decoders for rock-solid 4K HEVC rendering
• ⚡ Clean 'HF Direct' Row: Clean home screen layout with dedicated HF Direct catalog and instant stream badges
• 📱 Direct External Player Launch: Passed resolved CDN endpoints to external players (Just Player / VLC) with zero redirect latency
